props.caption: Strait of Hormuz. The IRGC says one of two tankers struck by mines sank; vessel identity and crew details were not given.
Bahrain says its air defenses intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks.
Nvidia’s board says its chief-executive search will consider internal and external candidates.

lead.what: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards say one of two tankers that struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz sank; no independent confirmation was reported.
Bahrain invoked Article 51 and appealed to the Security Council after reported drone attacks; the claimed radar hit was not confirmed.
A reported five-country Rwanda return-hub pilot remains unsigned; official and rights-group accounts describe talks, not a concluded agreement.

rest.what: Scott Bessent called for an external Nvidia chief-executive search while the board says it will consider internal and external candidates.
